hero.heading: How can we help?
hero.description: We're here to help you get the most out of HABOS. Find answers below or reach out directly.

email.label: Email Support
email.note: For all inquiries and support requests

items.question: What is HABOS?
items.answer: HABOS is the world's first Human-to-Agent Business Operating System — a single platform that replaces the dozen fragmented tools businesses juggle every day.

items.question: Which devices does HABOS support?
items.answer: HABOS works on any modern web browser. Access it from your desktop, laptop, tablet, or phone. Your data syncs seamlessly across all your devices.

items.question: How does billing work?
items.answer: HABOS offers subscription plans billed monthly or annually. Join the waitlist now for founding member pricing.

items.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. You'll continue to have access until the end of your current billing period.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact us at <email>hello@tryvois.com</email> or view our full <refund>Refund Policy</refund>.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Your privacy and data security are our top priority. We are fully GDPR compliant and use encryption to protect your data. Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for full details.

items.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
items.answer: We'd love to hear from you! Send us an email at <email>hello@tryvois.com</email> with a description of the issue or your feature idea, and we'll get back to you.
